name: Love at Vsynth Academy
source:
Kasane Teto can't stop getting second place to her class rep and crush, Hatsune Miku. With rumors of a string of murders going around and a best friend who suddenly says she has something to confess, Teto's life has been getting pretty hard lately!

[From [url=https://misamxsa.itch.io/love-at-vsynth-academy]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
卡萨内·特托 (Kasane Teto) 无法阻止自己获得第二名，落后于她的班代表和暗恋对象初音未来 (Hatsune Miku)。随着一系列谋杀案的传言四起，加上一位最好的朋友突然说她有事要坦白，特托最近的生活变得相当艰难！

[来自[url=https://misamxsa.itch.io/love-at-vsynth-academy]itch.io[/url]]
